preservationDecision: Keep evidence-audit-v1.json, evidence-audit-v2.json, and all V1/V2 artifacts immutable. V3 adds a budget-matched mitigation experiment and does not rewrite earlier evidence.

officialEvidenceSources.name: official-v2-baselines-and-default-reference
officialEvidenceSources.role: canonical custom baselines and default kube-scheduler placement reference

verifiedClaims.claim: Each arm and seed received exactly 72 fresh optimizer samples; one-shot evaluated 72 candidates while two-stage evaluated 42 candidates and used 30 additional promotion samples.
verifiedClaims.strength: frozen protocol and official observed budget

verifiedClaims.claim: Across three seeds, each arm consumed 216 optimizer samples; one-shot evaluated 216 candidates and two-stage evaluated 126 candidates. Together the arms executed 1,350 workload replays and 32,400 Pods with zero unschedulable results.
Under shared ten-repeat validation, two of three one-shot finalists and one of three two-stage finalists were false Pareto discoveries under the repeated-mean point-estimate rule.
verifiedClaims.strength: official repeated shared validation; descriptive small-denominator comparison

verifiedClaims.claim: Shared validation completed 270 workload executions and 6,480 Pods with complete decision, Kubernetes, and evaluator timestamps and zero unschedulable results.
On the fixed mixed-burst holdout, one of three shared-validation survivors remained nondominated under the repeated-mean exact point-estimate rule.
verifiedClaims.strength: official repeated holdout; descriptive support for one fixed workload

verifiedClaims.claim: The surviving two-stage policy and consolidation-heavy baseline both averaged 2.1 occupied workers; their mean p95 values differed by 42.985865 microseconds and their marginal 95 percent Student-t intervals overlapped strongly.
verifiedClaims.strength: official repeated holdout exact point estimates; no practical or statistical superiority claim

verifiedClaims.claim: The holdout workload was unseen to V3 search and policy selection, but earlier V2 baseline-only results were known before the V3 holdout protocol was frozen.
The default kube-scheduler is retained only as a common placement reference because it does not emit the custom scheduler's decision timestamp.
verifiedClaims.strength: official V2 external-reference observation and measurement-source boundary

supported: Two-stage resampling produced fewer false Pareto discoveries than one-shot control among three selected finalists per arm under the frozen shared-validation protocol.
One V3 two-stage survivor remained nondominated on the fixed holdout under exact repeated-mean point-estimate dominance.
The live evaluator completed all official V3 budgets without unschedulable Pods or missing timestamp coverage.
excluded: Two-stage resampling is statistically or generally superior to one-shot search.
The holdout survivor is practically or statistically superior to the consolidation-heavy baseline.
The mixed-burst holdout is fully blinded.
The V3 policies generalize to other workloads or production clusters.
The custom scheduler is faster or better than the default kube-scheduler.

checks: Left-panel counts are 2/3 for one-shot and 1/3 for two-stage.
Right-panel point estimates and marginal intervals match the committed holdout summary.
Marker shapes distinguish baselines, dropped survivors, and the remaining survivor in grayscale.
The caption states that confidence intervals do not define Pareto dominance.

closureChecks.visualInspection: all six pages rendered; the V3 two-panel figure was reviewed at 150 dpi with no clipping or label overlap
closureChecks.numericAudit: paper values and figure coordinates cross-checked against committed V3 search, shared-validation, and holdout summaries

residualLimitations: Each arm has only three seeds and three selected finalists, so the false-discovery comparison is descriptive.
Each 24-Pod replay's interpolated p95 depends on the 22nd and 23rd ordered observations.
Marginal confidence intervals are not a multivariate Pareto significance procedure.
The holdout is unseen to V3 selection but not fully blinded because prior V2 baseline-only outcomes were known.
kind workers are homogeneous containers on one physical host.
Maximum workload-occupied workers is a consolidation proxy, not powered-node cost.
The default kube-scheduler is a placement reference, not a latency baseline.

decision.nextAction: Add V3 regeneration and paper-audit checks to the repository verification entrypoint, then update the KubeCon proposal from the same bounded claim set.
